func show_map():
				var popup = map_select.instance()
				PopupManager.show_popup(popup, self)

func _process(delta: float) -> void :
				breathe_time += delta
				update()

func _draw() -> void :
				._draw()
				var phase = sin(breathe_time * TAU * 0.2)
				var active = nearby
				var outer_radius = 26.0 + 1.5 * phase
				var ring_alpha = 0.40 if not active else 0.65
				ring_alpha = ring_alpha + 0.04 * (1.0 + phase)
				var halo1_alpha = 0.035 if not active else 0.06
				var halo2_alpha = 0.055 if not active else 0.09
				var inner_alpha = 0.22 if not active else 0.35
				draw_circle(Vector2.ZERO, 34.0, Color(0.47451, 0.85098, 0.545098, halo1_alpha))
				draw_circle(Vector2.ZERO, 28.0, Color(0.47451, 0.85098, 0.545098, halo2_alpha))
				draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, outer_radius, 0.0, TAU, 48, Color(0.47451, 0.85098, 0.545098, ring_alpha), 2.0, true)
				draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, 19.0, 0.0, TAU, 40, Color(0.47451, 0.85098, 0.545098, inner_alpha), 1.0, true)
